hypothesis: A bounded design gate can convert the accepted M2887/M2888 dataset contract and M2889 synthesis into an actor-safe capability-prediction modeling contract before any implementation or training.

parent_objective: define the actor-safe capability-prediction modeling contract after M2889 admits modeling-contract design
blocked_by: The M2887/M2888 contract is complete but not yet converted into modeling features labels splits losses and gates
Capability-prediction implementation must not start until target visibility and split semantics are fixed
The 17 usable rows are too small for paper or ranking claims and must remain a design surface
Evaluator-only targets must remain outside actor input
supersedes: starting a capability-prediction data loader or model implementation without a modeling contract
training directly on M2887 public rows without split and holdout policy
claiming finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID evidence from dataset-contract rows

stop_condition: stop if actor-safe feature and evaluator-only target boundaries cannot be specified
stop if the 17-row contract cannot support meaningful split or holdout semantics even for a preflight

fallback_plan: route to a bounded modeling implementation preflight if the contract is sufficient
route to fresh/source-diverse data-panel design if source diversity or split coverage is too weak

route to Route A or Route C if capability-prediction is not the highest-leverage next step
stop the branch if no actor-safe evidence-producing follow-up exists

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the 17-row contract cannot support fair modeling semantics, route to fresh/source-diverse data design or stop rather than weakening self-ID gates.
